activity_summary: You looked at Brooke open under the candle, the notes beside it, two names struck and a plan of two houses. The cat's grey flank lay across the right-hand page. No face was in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the page and did not shift the cat.

entities.name: Romeus and Juliet
entities.context: Mentioned in Gib on the right-hand page

facets.activity: Left the cat where he had sat
